label: Educator / Faculty
mission: Build the orientation I wish I had been given — and make it outlive my assignment.
sub: Joanne Whitfield, MSN, RN, CNE · nursing faculty · two clinical groups · nineteen years at the bedside before this.
seasonBody: You are converting nineteen years of instinct into things other people can run. Everything you write this term outlives your contract — that is the point of the term.
seasonMeta: Week 9 of 16 · cohort week 3 of 6 · two clinical groups · curriculum review 4 December

actions.title: Close the loop on Tuesday’s near-miss
actions.why: You logged it as a lesson but never debriefed it with the student. The debrief is where learning lands, and it is the one you keep deferring.
actions.cost: 15 minutes · no PHI in the note, as always

actions.title: Build the handoff-script module you keep re-noting
actions.why: The same idea has surfaced in your capture inbox four times since May. That is the system telling you it wants to exist.

actions.title: Prep your two minutes for faculty senate
actions.why: The AI-in-coursework policy is on Thursday’s agenda and you are the only person in the room who has actually used one under governance.
actions.cost: 8 minutes · waits at a human gate

health.signal: Walks held four mornings a week since August.
health.detail: The most boring line on this screen and the reason the rest of it works. Nothing to fix.

family.signal: Grading moved off Sunday. Nine weeks and it has held.
family.detail: You moved grading to Thursday evenings in July to get Sundays back. It worked, and it is the change most worth protecting.

career.signal: Faculty senate seat active. Two clinical groups, no coverage gaps.
career.detail: Steady is the correct reading in a rebuild term. Your credential currency is held separately, above — it is not a share of your week.

learning.signal: CNE renewal hours 34 of 50. Two conference sessions logged.
learning.detail: On pace without effort, which is where you want a renewal cycle to sit. Nothing dated is at risk here.

finance.detail: Clean. The only finance domain on this prototype with nothing waiting — filing the same week is why.

creative.signal: Six modules drafted this term. Two now run without you in the room.
creative.detail: This is the domain where your season actually lives. Two modules taught by someone else is the definition of outliving the assignment.

service.signal: Two clinical groups, weekly office hours, three mentees.
service.detail: Your office hours have not been cancelled once this term. Students notice that far more than the syllabus.

business.signal: Consulting paused until the curriculum review clears in December.
business.detail: Logged with an end date on 12 June. It will not be surfaced as a signal until 4 December, so it stops competing.

momentum.label: returned to you this term by drafting, grading scaffolds, and module scaffolding you now reuse.
momentum.note: Estimated from your own logged times before and after each skill file. Conservative by design — teaching time is never counted as saved.
momentum.caption: the modules started compounding in week 6

reputation.name: Published
reputation.meta: 11 pieces carry your name · 11 reviewed by you · 0 auto-sent

reputation.name: Course materials
reputation.meta: 6 modules attributed to you · 2 now taught by others

reputation.name: Awaiting you
reputation.meta: 1 conference abstract drafted, unsent · deadline 30 August

risks.guard: Names, grades, remediation notes and evaluations are education records — FERPA-governed, not HIPAA, and no less protected. Import refuses on identifier patterns. The system catches it.

risks.what: A clinical story carried out of a rotation
risks.guard: Refused at every tier, in every sphere. A teaching anecdote is still a patient. The system catches it.

risks.what: Reaching for an ungoverned window instead
risks.guard: No governed system can reach a chat window it does not run. This one is yours to keep — it is the reason the rails are worth having.

license.scopeNote: Two privacy regimes meet in your role, not one. Patient information is HIPAA’s; student records are FERPA’s. This system refuses both by the same mechanism and makes no distinction between them — because from where you sit, neither belongs here.

signals.title: A conference abstract is drafted and unsent
signals.body: Deadline 30 August. It has been ready for nine days and needs your read, not more work.

signals.title: Tuesday’s near-miss has no debrief attached
signals.body: You logged the lesson. The student has not heard it yet, and that is where it becomes teaching.

signals.title: Two modules now run without you in the room
signals.body: That is the season’s stated goal, already met at week nine. Worth noticing before you set the next one.

signals.title: Nine library pages predate the curriculum change
signals.body: Stale teaching material is worse than none — it is confidently out of date.

opps.title: Your handoff module is a paper
opps.body: Six months of iteration and two independent instructors already running it. That is a methods section.

opps.title: A second cohort has asked for your slot
opps.body: Same six-week format, different program. Nothing new to build.

opps.title: Your former preceptee is now charge
opps.body: She asked about co-teaching in June. Your notes say you meant to reply.

opps.title: Two modules would sanitize in one pass
opps.body: No student data, no patient stories, no employer content. Clean as written.

agents.name: Florence
agents.scope: All spheres, read-only outside Health. Drafts freely; sends nothing.

agents.name: Scholar
agents.scope: Learning sphere. Reads your module drafts and the public literature; never student records.

agents.name: Scribe
agents.scope: Creativity sphere. No calendar, no gradebook, no outbound send.
